info.title: Workspace membership contract — ID-B/B1

get.description: Creation and owner mutations/retries require recent actual authentication under DeploymentSessionPolicy.recent_auth_seconds. Read routes require a current session only. No bearer-only or mixed authentication. Current quarantine blocks mutations and member listing; only caller-visible workspace/self status reads are permitted. Browser transport must enforce the complete ID-A cookie, origin, CSRF, caching and fixed-error rules.

parameters.description: Bounded page size.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Opaque server cursor bound to principal, workspace (for members), filter and snapshot. Recheck authority on each page.
parameters.name: cursor
